about.title: Moorpark Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision changes everything, and the paperwork and deadlines that follow can feel impossible to face while grieving. Moorpark saw 96 injury collisions and 1 traffic death in the most recent reporting year, with crashes tending to cluster on Wednesday afternoons along corridors like Los Angeles Avenue, Tierra Rejada Road, and SR-118. When a crash on one of these Ventura County roads takes a loved one, California law allows certain surviving family members to pursue a civil wrongful death claim separate from any criminal case. LawProactive is not a law firm — we're a free service that connects grieving families with an independent personal injury attorney who can explain standing, deadlines, and what losses may be recoverable. There's no cost to speak with someone, and no obligation to move forward until you're ready.

whyChoose.title: What Grieving Families in Moorpark Should Know

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain other dependents or heirs. An independent attorney can help determine who qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: The Clock Is Shorter Than You Might Expect
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and claims against a government entity carry an even shorter deadline. Waiting too long can close the door on a claim entirely.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows families to seek funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and compensation for lost love, companionship, and guidance. An attorney can help explain how these losses are documented and valued.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, and children. If none of those exist, certain other dependents or heirs may have standing. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and clarify who can bring the claim.

items.question: Does a crash on SR-118 or Los Angeles Avenue in Moorpark change how a claim works?
items.answer: The location matters mainly for identifying which agency maintains the road and gathering local crash records, since Moorpark's higher-volume corridors like SR-118, Los Angeles Avenue, and Tierra Rejada Road generate public collision data that can support a claim. The core legal process and deadlines under California law remain the same regardless of the specific street.

items.question: How long do we have to file after losing a loved one?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as a public road authority, may be involved, the deadline is often much shorter, so it helps to speak with an attorney as soon as you're able.
